args.question:
Fjord Analytics (V-653) has two approved invoices, so I need you to tell me which one to pay before I send anything:
- INV-30414: $2,006.67, due 2026-11-04
- INV-72044: $7,969.82, due 2026-11-25
Both are under the $10,000 controller-approval threshold. Which should I pay in full by wire (ACH if wire is unavailable)? I have not sent any payment yet.
